basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, with a deep love for gaming and modding. During the day, I work as a software developer, and at night, I'm usually found tweaking GTA V mods or diving into the latest space sims. I'm also a huge fan of sci-fi, both in literature and film, and enjoy discussing the finer points of interstellar travel and alien life. On weekends, I often participate in local gaming meetups. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies. My typical online hours are evenings and late nights, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been modding games since my college days. My expertise in software development helps me troubleshoot and enhance game mods effectively. Over the years, I've honed my skills through trial and error, and by participating in online communities where I exchange tips and tricks with fellow modders.
